title: The meter-replacement programme
from: Jamila Al-Shuraim, head of customer operations
question: In the first phase of the programme, 20 of our 30 districts took part, and 8 of them had their old meters replaced with smart meters. An estimated bill is one we could not read and had to guess. Did the smart meters reduce estimated bills, and by how much? I have to decide whether to fund the other 12 districts.
columns: household_key (pseudonym), district, meter (old or smart), household_size, estimated_bills_12m (estimated bills in the last 12 months, 0 to 12)
think_about: The rollout was by district, not by household. Counts of bills are skewed.

title: The conservation-message pilot
from: Jamila Al-Shuraim, head of customer operations
question: Forty neighbourhoods took part in a pilot. Twenty, chosen by lot, received a monthly message comparing their consumption with their neighbours'. Did the message reduce consumption, by how many litres a day, and is it worth sending to everyone? Our planners say a saving below 10 litres a day per household does not pay for the programme.
columns: household_key (pseudonym), neighbourhood, arm (message or control), household_size, litres_day_before, litres_day_after
think_about: The lot was drawn by neighbourhood. Every neighbourhood changed between the two months for reasons of its own. There is a threshold.

title: The call-back change
question: Since the new rule, the complaints desk calls every customer back within one working day. Did complaints get resolved faster after the change, for which types of complaint, and by how much? I am asked to extend the rule to both centres permanently.
columns: complaint_key (pseudonym), period (before or after), centre (North or South), type (six types), complexity (1 to 5), resolution_hours
think_about: Resolution times are skewed. Six types are six comparisons. Before and after is not a randomised comparison.
